INSERT INTO dm_dashboard_snapshot (tenant_id, snapshot_date, metric_code, metric_value) SELECT tenant_id, #{date}, 'COMPONENT_TOTAL', COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE enabled = 1 GROUP BY tenant_id
